༄༅/ /bcom ldan ma hā mā yā'i tshogs mchod 'dod dgu myur ster zhes pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan ma hā mā yā'i tshogs mchod 'dod dgu myur ster zhes pa bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā yā'i sgrub mchod dam/ dbang bskur la sogs pa'i dus rnal 'byor pho mo zung du gyur pa'i dpa' bo'i ston mo bya bar yang gsungs te/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i gnas nyid dang*// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo yi// ston mor gyur pa nyid dang yang*// sna tshogs ston mo'i rim shes pas// thabs dang shes rab gsang ba yis// mchog tu gyur pa 'dir brjod yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar bya bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ thabs shes kyi rdzas rnams stag gi pags pa'i steng du bshams la bdud rtsi bran zhing*/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam/ zhes pa nas/ ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ na mo/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar rgyas btab pa 'di/ 'bul ba'i gnas ni byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ hūm̐/ rang snang chos sku'i klong yangs nas// bka' brgyud bla ma sprin ltar gtibs// 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// mchog thun dngos grub char chen stsol// 'og min mkha' spyod zhing khams nas// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// mchog thun dngos grub char chen stsol// mkha' khams rnam par dag pa yi// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bde chen yum// 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// mchog thun dngos grub char chen stsol// sa khams rnam par dag pa yi// mi 'gyur rdo rje ḍā ki ma// 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// mchog thun dngos grub char chen stsol// chu khams rnam par dag pa yi// yon tan rin chen ḍā ki ma// 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// mchog thun dngos grub char chen stsol// me khams rnam par dag pa yi// gsung mchog pad+ma ḍā ki ma// 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// mchog thun dngos grub char chen stsol// rlung khams rnam par dag pa yi// sna tshogs phrin las ḍā ki ma// 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// mchog thun dngos grub char chen stsol// dam tshig gnyen po'i bka' sdod pa'i// chos skyong zhing skyong ma lus pa// 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// mngon spyod las rnams thogs med sgrubs//

de nas tshogs phud dkyil 'khor drung du 'bul nas bdud rtsi bran la/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyi bar/ bcom ldan yab yum lha mo bzhi dur khrod pa rnams dang bcas pa'i ljags hūm̐ las sogs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sogs nas/ ha ha ho phaṭa bar lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan sogs kyis 'jig rten pa rnams la chos bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ k+ṣe tra pā la nas/ swā hā 'i bar lan gsum gyis phul/ he ru ka dpal sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod// ces sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ de nas las rdor gyis/ slob dpon nas brtsams te 'dus pa thams cad la thabs shes kyi rdzas snod so sor gnas pa dag /lag pa gnyis g.yas g.yon brtsegs thabs su bsnol bzhin pas bzung nas/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// ces brjod la drang ngo*// len pa pos pad kor dang bcas te/ bde gshegs chos ni rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// ces brjod cing blangs te/ bza' btung la nye bar spyad pa'i tshe/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i dbus kyi lha tshogs mchod pa'i tshul lam/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis rol par byas pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje'i glu yang bya ste/ 'gro ba kun ni mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te// rnal 'byor ma ni 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas kyi// sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin// snying rjes gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol par byos// gang gis don dam la ni ma bsgoms par// de yis sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin no// nang dang phyi ni dbye ba med par shes par gyis// 'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o//

zhes pa'i sh+tsau ka gnyis po so so'i mthar/ a re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so// lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos// zhes drug 'gyur du blang ba'i mthar/ lhag ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum brjod/ lhag ma'i rdzas rnams 'byung po'i tshogs kyis nyer spyad du 'os pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ zhes dmigs/ phyi rol sgo drung na gnas pa'i 'byung po 'chol ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga blta bar mi dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ lhag ma rgyang ring du dor/ bshal chu shin tu lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// de nas mchod bstod bzod gsol sogs dkyus ltar bya'o// de ltar bcom ldan 'das sgyu 'phrul chen po'i mngon dkyil 'od mtshan 'chang ba bzhi pas bkral bar gnang ba la/ tshogs mchod gud du sbyar ba 'di nyid 'jang 'og min gling gi bla ma dbang rgyal gyis nye bar bskul ba ltar sa zla'i yar tshes la dpal spungs thub bstan gling gi yang dben sgrub brgyud dar rgyas gling du si tu sprul sku pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba 'gro kun sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chen po'i go 'phang la reg par gyur cig /shu bhaṃ/// /
